name: veda-bot
description: This repository provides a rapid deployment template for building Discord bots using Discord.js version 14 with Typescript. It includes ready-to-use code for handling commands, events, and interactions, so you can get your bot up and running quickly.
author: pixlze

scripts.copy: npx copyfiles -u 1 src/.env src/**/*.json src/**/*.png dist/
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run prettier && npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.start: npx copyfiles -u 1 src/.env src/**/*.json src/**/*.png dist/ && cd dist && node . && cd ..
scripts.dev: npm run clean && tsc-watch --onSuccess "npm run start"
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start
